evals.prompt: Our app is opening username signup. Add a reserved-handle policy covering routes, 1-3 character names, common names, and impersonation-prone developer identities without permanently banning legitimate claimants.
evals.expected_output: A two-tier policy with hard reservations, manual claims, confusable normalization, an inspectable TOML registry, explicit API reasons, and tests.

evals.prompt: Audit our existing signup and profile rename code. People can register @admin and @a_i, and the API just says taken for everything. Fix the policy and user-facing semantics.
evals.expected_output: An implementation audit and fix that distinguishes hard reserved, taken, and manual review while covering separator skeletons.

evals.prompt: Refresh our protected social handles from current public rankings, but explain what data is defensible and avoid importing a junk Reddit leaderboard.
evals.expected_output: A dated, source-attributed refresh with collision reporting, preserved ranks, and a curated Reddit rationale.
